prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find, grab & process object; avoid obstacle or turn around; move forward.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInReach    /> <Action ID = TurnAround    /> <Condition ID = IsObstacleInFront    /> <Action ID = AvoidObstacle    /> <Action ID = MoveForward    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectInReach? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
